title: REC Membership
consent_intro: Before proceeding, please accept the following consents for data collection.
upload_bill_optional: If you have a utility bill, upload it to auto-fill your details. You can also skip this step.
upload_bill_hint: Take a photo or upload a file (PDF, JPG, PNG)
gdpr_consent: I consent to the processing of personal data under GDPR
policy_consent: I accept the energy community policy
statute_consent: I accept the energy community statute
keep_me_updated: I'd like to receive updates and communications about the REC
eligibility_intro: Verify that your supply address is within the energy community coverage area.
eligibility_ok: Your address is in the coverage area!
eligibility_fail: Your address is not in the energy community coverage area.
phone_verify_intro: Verify your phone number — we'll send you a code by SMS.
phone_code_sent: We sent you a code by SMS. Enter it below.
phone_send_failed: Could not send the code. Please try again.
phone_confirm_failed: Could not verify the code. Please try again.
submit_success_detail: You will receive a confirmation email.
submit_login_invitation: Once your application is approved, you will receive an email to set the password for your account. The link is valid for 7 days. After setting your password, sign in with it.
upload_id_intro: To speed things up, please upload an ID document belonging to the same person as the utility bill. If that's not possible, no worries — we'll collect it later.
upload_id_hint: Identity card, electronic ID (CIE), or passport (photo or scan, front and back)
upload_id_format: Take a photo or upload a file (PDF, JPG, PNG)
mismatch_title: Bill and ID document data do not match:
id_expired: The identity document expired on {{date}}. Upload a valid one, or remove it: uploading it is optional.
data_sharing_title: Share your data with the community
data_sharing_intro: Optionally, you can let the energy community use your data for the purposes below. You can change your mind at any time.
data_sharing_unavailable: The data-sharing options are temporarily unavailable, so we cannot ask you about them right now. This does not affect your application — you can complete it as normal, and you will be able to decide later.
data_sharing_disclosed_note: This use rests on a contractual basis, so it is disclosed for your information — no separate consent is required.
data_sharing_optional: Sharing is optional and never a condition of joining the community. The community app works with your meter data, though: without it, its features cannot work.
error_extraction_unavailable: We couldn't read your document right now. Please fill in the fields yourself, or try uploading it again in a few minutes.
error_server: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment.
error_rate_limited: Too many attempts in a short time. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
error_network: We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
existing_member: I am already a member of {{community}}. I ask {{community}} to complete my POD code and supply address with the details it already holds in its member register.
existing_member_pod_only: I am already a member of {{community}}. I ask {{community}} to complete my POD code with the details it already holds in its member register.
existing_member_hint: We will ask you for less: {{community}} will complete the rest from its member register.
existing_member_pod_hint: Don't have it to hand? Leave it empty: {{community}} will complete it.
